title: A user signs in and opens a workspace with a leader, a persona and a goal
recording: slim: analyze.json + result.json; code, test and validate are one `work` phase evidenced by git and the tests (owner-approved 2026-09-19)

goals.description: Supabase auth sign in / out with the publishable key; session cached locally so offline open needs no token refresh
Workspace create: team + board + column + session in one transaction via create_workspace (DB-Q6); the creator picks the leader
Workspace persona (leader) and personal persona (self) editors; one active persona per person
WorkspaceShell — document area, right rail, header with sync pill, mode switch, theme switch; app-header and auth-guard live in features/workspace
The workspace route is a client component loaded ssr:false; no SSR data dependency
